blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — The local government of San Jose in Occidental Mindoro has launched a donation drive to protect the endangered tamaraw, a wild buffalo endemic to Mindoro. The “Piso Para sa Tamaraw” campaign was launched by the municipal government through its Municipal Tourism, Culture and the Arts Office (MTCAO) and Municipal Environment and Natural Resources Office (MENRO). The campaign coincides with the observance of Tamaraw Conservation Month this October. This initiative encourages individuals, families, students, workers and community groups to contribute whatever amount they can for the project.
